scope: U.S. Supreme Court OT2019-OT2025 merits decisions and noted shadow-docket orders in Fourth Amendment, Fifth Amendment interrogation, Sixth Amendment field-context, and Section 1983/qualified-immunity/FTCA/Bivens officer-liability space; doubtful candidates intentionally included.
source_crosscheck_method: For each term, official supremecourt.gov opinions/opinions-relating-to-orders lists were used as the base roster and cross-checked against Wikipedia term-opinions pages plus targeted SCOTUSblog/Oyez/case-page references where needed; CourtListener was not used.
